activity.overview: Listen for the sound two letters make together.
activity.passage: Letter buddies are two letters that make one sound. Sh says /sh/ in ship. Ch says /ch/ in chop. Th says /th/ in thin. Wh says /wh/ in when. Listen to each word and find the buddy.

questions.prompt: Say shop. What letter buddy do you hear at the start?
Say chin. What letter buddy do you hear at the start?
Say bath. What letter buddy do you hear at the end?
Say a word that starts with /sh/.

activity.subject: english-language-arts
activity.title: Meet the Letter Buddies
